title: Windows activity correlation pack
notes: Covers high-signal Windows authentication, privilege, persistence, remote access, and endpoint-protection activity for workstation and server telemetry.

stream_rules.title: Windows Logon Failure Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Review the principal, client address, and target host before deciding whether to suppress, lock, or escalate the authentication activity.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Windows Logon Failure Burst
id: sigma-windows-logon-failure-burst
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    event.provider: windows.security
    event.type: windows_logon_failure
  condition: selection
level: medium

stream_rules.title: Windows Audit Log Cleared
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect the actor, validate whether the clear event was approved maintenance, and check for adjacent tampering or defense-evasion activity.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Windows Audit Log Cleared
id: sigma-windows-audit-log-cleared
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    event.provider: windows.security
    event.type: windows_audit_log_cleared
  condition: selection
level: high

stream_rules.title: Windows Privileged Group Membership Change
stream_rules.operator_action: Confirm the user, target group, and operator are expected. If not, remove the privilege and review preceding logon or admin activity.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Windows Privileged Group Membership Change
id: sigma-windows-privileged-group-membership-change
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    event.provider: windows.security
    event.type: windows_user_added_to_privileged_group
  condition: selection
level: high

stream_rules.title: Windows Encoded PowerShell Command
stream_rules.operator_action: Review the command line, user context, and parent process. Treat unexpected encoded execution as possible defense evasion or post-exploitation.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'windows.powershell' and event.type == 'windows_powershell_encoded_command' and not event.original icontains 'RdegonSIEMCollector' and not event.original icontains 'rdegon-siem-collector.ps1' and not event.original icontains 'C:\ProgramData\RdegonSIEM' and not event.original icontains 'collector-state.json' and not event.original icontains '[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8' and not event.original icontains 'Get-Content -Path repo' and not event.original icontains 'Long-lived PowerShell AST parser used by the Rust command-safety layer' and not event.original icontains 'SIEM direct encoded test' and not event.original icontains 'runtime-control-plane' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: Windows Service Installed
stream_rules.operator_action: Validate the service name, binary path, and install source. Escalate unexpected service creation as persistence or unauthorized software deployment.
stream_rules.expr: (event.type == 'windows_service_installed' and not event.original icontains 'RdegonSIEMCollector' and not event.original icontains 'rdegon-siem-collector.ps1' and not event.original icontains 'C:\ProgramData\RdegonSIEM' and not event.original icontains 'collector-state.json' and not event.original icontains 'WinDefend' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: Windows User Created
stream_rules.operator_action: Check whether the account creation is tied to approved provisioning. Investigate unknown local-user creation together with admin and remote-login activity.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Windows User Created
id: sigma-windows-user-created
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    event.type: windows_user_created
  condition: selection
level: medium

stream_rules.title: Windows Scheduled Task Created
stream_rules.operator_action: Review the task author, schedule, and launched command. Unexpected scheduled tasks are a common persistence mechanism on Windows assets.
stream_rules.expr: (event.type == 'windows_scheduled_task_created' and not event.original icontains 'RdegonSIEMCollector' and not event.original icontains 'rdegon-siem-collector' and not event.original icontains 'Microsoft\Windows\UpdateOrchestrator' and not event.original icontains 'Microsoft\Windows\Defrag' and not event.original icontains '\SoftLanding\' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: Windows Registry Persistence Change
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect the modified registry path and value. Repeated registry writes can indicate autorun persistence, policy tampering, or malware staging.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Windows Registry Persistence Change
id: sigma-windows-registry-persistence-change
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: sysmon
detection:
  selection:
    event.type: windows_registry_value_set
  condition: selection
level: high

stream_rules.title: Windows Suspicious Process Creation Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect parent-child chains and command lines. Repeated suspicious process creation can indicate script abuse, payload launch, or hands-on-keyboard activity.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Windows Suspicious Process Creation Burst
id: sigma-windows-suspicious-process-creation-burst
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: sysmon
detection:
  selection:
    event.type: windows_process_create
  condition: selection
level: medium

stream_rules.title: Windows User Deleted
stream_rules.operator_action: Verify whether the deletion belongs to approved user lifecycle operations. Unexpected removals can hide account abuse or cleanup after compromise.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Windows User Deleted
id: sigma-windows-user-deleted
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    event.type: windows_user_deleted
  condition: selection
level: medium

stream_rules.title: Windows Special Privileges Assigned
stream_rules.operator_action: Review privileged logons and the originating session. Unexpected assignment of special privileges often precedes lateral movement or admin misuse.
stream_rules.expr: (event.type == 'windows_special_privileges_assigned' and user.name != 'SYSTEM' and not (host.name == 'DESKTOP-5JMJVBH' and user.name == 'Rdegon') and not event.original icontains 'Security ID:		S-1-5-18' and not event.original icontains 'Account Name:		SYSTEM' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: Windows Explicit Credentials Logon
stream_rules.operator_action: Validate why explicit credentials were supplied and whether the target host or service matches approved administration activity.
stream_rules.expr: (event.type == 'windows_explicit_credentials_logon' and not (process.name == 'svchost.exe' and user.name icontains '$' and event.original icontains 'Security ID:		S-1-5-18' and event.original icontains 'Target Server Name:	localhost') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: Windows Audit Policy Changed
stream_rules.operator_action: Treat unexpected audit policy changes as potential defense evasion. Confirm whether logging was reduced, redirected, or selectively disabled.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Windows Audit Policy Changed
id: sigma-windows-audit-policy-changed
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    event.type: windows_audit_policy_changed
  condition: selection
level: high

stream_rules.title: Windows Password Reset Or Change
stream_rules.operator_action: Validate who changed or reset the password, for which account, and whether the operation belongs to approved helpdesk or administration work.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Windows Password Reset Or Change
id: sigma-windows-password-reset-or-change
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    event.type:
      - windows_password_changed
      - windows_password_reset
  condition: selection
level: high

stream_rules.title: Windows Defender Malware Detected
stream_rules.operator_action: Validate the malware family, affected path, and whether Defender quarantined the artifact. Escalate quickly if execution or lateral movement indicators exist nearby.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Windows Defender Malware Detected
id: sigma-windows-defender-malware-detected
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: defender
detection:
  selection:
    event.type: windows_defender_malware_detected
  condition: selection
level: high

stream_rules.title: Windows Defender Configuration Changed
stream_rules.operator_action: Review which Defender setting changed and whether protection was weakened. Unexpected configuration drift should be treated as possible tampering.
stream_rules.expr: (event.type == 'windows_defender_configuration_changed' and (event.original icontains 'DisableRealtimeMonitoring' or event.original icontains 'DisableBehaviorMonitoring' or event.original icontains 'DisableIOAVProtection' or event.original icontains 'DisableAntiSpyware' or event.original icontains 'DisableAntiVirus' or event.original icontains 'DisableScriptScanning' or event.original icontains 'DisableBlockAtFirstSeen' or event.original icontains 'TamperProtection' or event.original icontains 'PUAProtection' or event.original icontains 'Exclusions\Paths' or event.original icontains 'Exclusions\Extensions' or event.original icontains 'Exclusions\Processes' or event.original icontains 'Spynet\SubmitSamplesConsent' or event.original icontains 'MAPSReporting' or event.original icontains 'CloudBlockLevel') and not event.original icontains 'UX Configuration\ToastOrSsoTrigger' and not event.original icontains 'MpEngine\MpEngineRing' and not event.original icontains 'MpEngine\MpCampRing' and not event.original icontains 'Signature Updates' and not event.original icontains 'Security intelligence version updated' and not event.original icontains 'CoreService\WdConfigHash' and not event.original icontains 'Features\EcsConfigs' and not event.original icontains 'Features\Controls' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: Windows RDP Authentication Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect the remote address, principal, and destination host. Repeated successful RDP logons can indicate lateral movement or shared-admin account misuse.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Windows RDP Authentication Burst
id: sigma-windows-rdp-authentication-burst
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: terminalservices
detection:
  selection:
    event.type: windows_rdp_auth_success
  condition: selection
level: medium

stream_rules.title: Windows WMI Activity Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Review WMI activity context, parent process, and operator identity. Bursts of WMI usage often indicate remote execution, discovery, or post-exploitation tradecraft.
stream_rules.expr: (event.type == 'windows_wmi_activity' and (event.action == 'wmi_remote_query' or event.action == 'wmi_remote_execution') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: Windows WMI Permanent Event Consumer
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect the WMI filter, consumer, and binding. Permanent WMI consumers are a high-signal persistence mechanism unless tied to an approved management agent.
stream_rules.expr: (event.type == 'windows_wmi_activity' and event.action == 'wmi_persistence' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

batch_rules.title: Windows Privilege Change Review
batch_rules.description: Batch review of privileged-group changes and adjacent admin activity across Windows assets.

batch_rules.title: Windows Remote Administration Review
batch_rules.description: Batch review of RDP, explicit-credential, WMI, and special-privilege activity across Windows assets.
